seedInfluence: none: no RNG draw enters the isolated movement protocol; seeds are reproducibility labels

protocol.dt: 1 / canonical session profile tickHz: 1/15, 1/12, 1/10 seconds for Shallows, Expanse, Deep Field
protocol.input: moveX=shortest-path unit direction, moveY=shortest-path unit direction, thrust=1, brake=0; held for every tick
protocol.cruise: canonical baseline brain defaults, sustained full-stick thrust, no burn, no flow, no entity forces
protocol.burst: Breacher default brain with existing Burn active; burn thrustMult and fuelMax read from HULL_DEFINITIONS, no slingshot
protocol.deltaV: sufficientDeltaV=true from AUTHORED_MAP_CONTRACT.travel; movement lane uses a 1e9 delta-v reserve so depletion cannot become the measured travel time
protocol.flow: zero current sample; no wells, stars, planetoids, waves, gravity, contacts, or collisions
protocol.termination: stop after accumulated path distance reaches target distance; measured time is completed simulation ticks
protocol.probes: one cell = 1 current registry world unit; full-width = one toroidal map circumference; route legs use current authored route anchors and shortest toroidal distance

units.currentRegistry: map dimensions are world units; current measurement uses 1 wu = 1 provisional cell for placement math
units.fictionScale: unresolved and intentionally not ratified; no meters conversion is claimed

decisionsPerMinuteProxy.definition: 60 / (cruise seconds per cell × sensor radius in provisional cells)
